findings.description: pip-audit reported a known vulnerability for a pinned Python dependency.
findings.evidence: flask@3.0.3 is affected by CVE-2026-27205, GHSA-68rp-wp8r-4726.
findings.remediation: Upgrade flask to one of the fixed versions: 3.1.3.
